posts.cooked:
Greetings!

Patch 34.6.1 is a server‑side hotfix patch, rolling out today, Feb 17. Please find the details below.

Bug Fixes and Game Improvements

Hearthstone
  • Farseer Wo now correctly continues generating spells, even after a double rewind.
  • Eternal Life (from Husk, Eternal Reaper) will no longer trigger for both players when a hero dies to a card effect.
  • Splendiferous Whizbang has found another couple of treasures to put in his rogue deck. No pirates were harmed in the process, but they looked pretty upset.
  • Ladder Ready Decks now properly become available for eligible players after the intended 90-day cooldown.
Battlegrounds
  • Golden Timewarped Shadequill has had its description corrected (gain stats from 6 highest-health minions, rather than 3)
  • Timewarped Stone Drake now correctly activates for both players in Duos.
  • Timewarped Swirler now correctly affects cards of the ALL type (eg. The Last One Standing)
  • Major Timewarped Tavern will now more reliably offer all intended cards.
Arena
  • Timeway Wanderer once again correctly reduces the cost of spells it discovers. It will be unbanned shortly after patch deployment.

Battlegrounds Balance Updates

Minion Pool Changes
  • Runed Progenitor has been returned to the minion pool.
    • Tavern Tier changed to 4 (from 5).
  • Treasure-Seeker Elise has been removed from the minion pool.
Card Updates

Forest Rover

  • Base: Battlecry now “Your Beetles have +2/+1 this game.” (was +1/+1).
  • Golden: Battlecry now “Your Beetles have +4/+2 this game.” (was +2/+2).
  • Deathrattles unchanged.

Turquoise Skitterer

  • Now Tavern Tier 5 (was 4).
  • Base Deathrattle now “Your Beetles have +5/+5 this game. Summon a 2/2 Beetle.” (was +1/+2).
  • Golden Deathrattle now “Your Beetles have +10/+10 this game. Summon two 2/2 Beetles.” (was +2/+4).

Time Snap is now Tier 7 (was 6).

Timewarp Balance Updates

Timewarp Pool Changes
  • Timewarped Seer has been removed from the Timewarp pool.
Minor Timewarps

Timewarped Pashmar

  • Avenge changed to “Avenge (3): Get a random Spellcraft spell and Tavern spell.” (was 4).
  • Golden: “Avenge (3): Get 2 random Spellcraft spells and Tavern spells.” (was 4).

Minor Timewarp – Cost Reductions

  • Now cost 1:
    • Timewarped Chimera
    • Timewarped Tipper
    • Timewarped Acolyte
    • Timewarped Traveler
    • Timewarped Zerus

Minor Timewarp – Cost Increases

  • Now cost 2:
    • Timewarped Piper
    • Timewarped Geomancer
    • Timewarped Guard
Major Timewarps

Timewarped Painter

  • Base: “At the end of your turn, give adjacent minions +2/+2…” (was +2/+1).
  • Golden: “At the end of your turn, give adjacent minions +4/+4…” (was +4/+2).

Timewarped Amalgam

  • Base: Buffs minions of that type in the Tavern by +4/+4 (was +3/+3).
  • Golden: +8/+8 (was +6/+6).

Timewarped Mystic

  • Base: After you sell 3 Murlocs, your Tavern spells give an extra +2/+1 (was +1/+1).
  • Golden: extra +4/+2 (was +2/+2).

Timewarped Geist

  • Base Deathrattle: Tavern spells give an extra +2/+2 (was +2/+1).
  • Golden Deathrattle: extra +4/+4 (was +4/+2).

Timewarped Bandit

  • Base: Plays 3 Blood Gems on all your minions (was 4).
  • Golden: Plays 6 Blood Gems (was 8).

Major Timewarp – Cost Changes

  • Timewarped Stone Drake now costs 1.
  • Now cost 2:
    • Timewarped Bonker
    • Timewarped Lil’ Quilboar
    • Timewarped Chameleon
